transitions.guard: explicit activation capability is present
transitions.effect: load the pinned product contract

transitions.guard: product contract digest matches the activation
transitions.effect: prepare immutable request storage

transitions.guard: ordered entries and object hashes validate
transitions.effect: resolve supported settings by precedence

transitions.guard: a required supported setting has no allowed source
transitions.effect: start no inspection or worker

transitions.guard: the new value is appended to the exact request record
transitions.effect: revalidate all settings

transitions.guard: effective numeric limits and user pins validate
transitions.effect: attempt one target lease

transitions.guard: lease identity is bound to activation and target
transitions.effect: select project history or a private side location

transitions.guard: another live owner holds the target lease
transitions.effect: touch no target or run file

transitions.guard: no-follow containment and target-effect checks pass
transitions.effect: create one run directory atomically

transitions.guard: neither project history nor a private side location is proven safe
transitions.effect: prepare BLOCKED outcome

transitions.guard: required files are atomic and the opened directory identity is bound
transitions.effect: compare required effects to verified provider support

transitions.guard: an atomic write, sync, hash, or state write failed
transitions.effect: preserve last valid state and prepare FAILED outcome

transitions.guard: every required feature is verified or has an accepted safe reduced behavior
transitions.effect: start exactly one read-only analyst

transitions.guard: the optional user path is exact, schema-valid, capability-safe, and immutable
transitions.effect: persist the exact route decision and bypass route-analysis and route-selection model work

transitions.guard: a required feature is unsupported or unverified without safe reduced behavior
transitions.effect: prepare BLOCKED outcome before production work

transitions.guard: analyst count is one and its target is read-only
transitions.effect: stream raw events into the transcript

transitions.guard: failure details are available
transitions.effect: save the failure and continue with lower confidence

transitions.guard: raw events or a typed failure and bounded index are durable
transitions.effect: give the run owner the recommendation and bounded index

transitions.guard: decision schema, route reasons, success list, and planned checks validate
transitions.effect: prepare only the selected route

transitions.guard: one indispensable user-owned choice is named and route is null
transitions.effect: start no worker

transitions.guard: no earlier correction was attempted
transitions.effect: allow one same-owner schema correction

transitions.guard: the one correction was used
transitions.effect: prepare FAILED outcome without production work

transitions.guard: the four-minute ceiling ended without a valid decision
transitions.effect: save unresolved facts and prepare FAILED outcome

transitions.guard: ownership, success items, checks, and route limits validate
transitions.effect: start only ready work

transitions.guard: the item result and its item-level checks share one version id
transitions.effect: record item completion without ending the run

transitions.guard: another accepted item is ready and ownership is free
transitions.effect: continue selected-route work

transitions.guard: all required items are joined and one exact version is frozen
transitions.effect: start independent checks

transitions.guard: a failing assertion, changed behavior, or exact diff fault identifies production work
transitions.effect: return affected work to the same useful worker

transitions.guard: the missing boundary follows from the exact request
transitions.effect: add a regression check and repair the affected work

transitions.guard: a recorded pre-change passing check is now failing
transitions.effect: repair or revert the affected change

transitions.guard: the check cannot run or measures the wrong target
transitions.effect: assign a check resolver without changing route

transitions.guard: the version or affected check evidence changed
transitions.effect: repeat only invalidated checks

transitions.guard: failure matches the declared retryable class and allowance remains
transitions.effect: retry the same step without route change

transitions.guard: the result is flaky, contradictory, partial, or non-authoritative
transitions.effect: isolate the check and use only its declared transient allowance

transitions.guard: the check produced a classified result tied to the same version
transitions.effect: continue the affected checking path

transitions.guard: the declared allowance ended without an authoritative result
transitions.effect: prepare PARTIAL outcome and record uncertainty

transitions.guard: same-context continuation is unavailable
transitions.effect: check provider-safe resume from saved assignment and exact version

transitions.guard: provider contract permits exact saved-assignment resume
transitions.effect: resume without cloning full history

transitions.guard: no safe continuation or named replacement is available and no accepted requested result survives
transitions.effect: prepare the FAILED outcome

transitions.guard: no safe continuation or named replacement is available and at least one accepted requested result survives
transitions.effect: prepare the PARTIAL outcome with the surviving completed result evidence

transitions.guard: two valid owned results cannot be combined under the accepted plan
transitions.effect: return the conflict to the integration owner

transitions.guard: the accepted plan still covers the resolved ownership order
transitions.effect: continue integration

transitions.guard: a new dependency or design fact is recorded
transitions.effect: re-evaluate the smallest sufficient route

transitions.guard: checking contradicts the recorded request interpretation
transitions.effect: consider DIRECT to LIGHT

transitions.guard: at least two dependent writable groups and an integration need are recorded
transitions.effect: consider LIGHT to ROADMAP

transitions.guard: a recorded architectural choice affects several systems or public contracts
transitions.effect: consider ROADMAP or user input

transitions.guard: a previously admitted required provider feature is unavailable
transitions.effect: use a declared safe alternative or stop

transitions.guard: a named risk dimension and its affected work or check are recorded
transitions.effect: add the named control without enlarging route unless its predicate is proven

transitions.guard: the new side effect and its authority and reversibility impact are recorded
transitions.effect: re-evaluate authority, isolation, and staged-change controls

transitions.guard: the shared resource identity and competing owners are recorded
transitions.effect: serialize ownership or change route only when dependent integration is proven

transitions.guard: the exact failed check, its authority, and its failure classification are recorded
transitions.effect: resolve the check or record an inconclusive result without inventing a pass

transitions.guard: failure fingerprint repeats with unchanged version and check evidence
transitions.effect: change approach once rather than starting equivalent workers

transitions.guard: a materially different bounded approach is recorded
transitions.effect: continue within the same route unless a route-change fact exists

transitions.guard: the reassessment proves an environment, policy, or capability blocker
transitions.effect: prepare BLOCKED outcome

transitions.guard: the choice is product-semantic, consequential, destructive, credentialed, costly, contradictory, or lacks permission
transitions.effect: ask only for the required user-owned choice

transitions.guard: a new fact and matching route rule are recorded
transitions.effect: invalidate only affected plans, work, and checks

transitions.guard: real checks pass the exact request with no relevant regression
transitions.effect: perform the final version-bound recheck

transitions.guard: the refinement remains within the success list and available budget
transitions.effect: invalidate dependent check results before mutation

transitions.guard: final results bind the current version, request, environment, and checks
transitions.effect: stop other working agents and prepare deterministic completion

transitions.guard: quiescence excludes only the current control action and deterministic finalizers
transitions.effect: prepare DONE outcome and release owned resources

transitions.guard: the exact failed command and unavailable dependency are recorded
transitions.effect: prepare BLOCKED outcome with an unblock path

transitions.guard: an authoritative failure remains after its bounded repair allowance or repair made no progress
transitions.effect: prepare FAILED outcome with the exact rejected result and repair evidence

transitions.guard: a typed internal control failure prevents safe continuation and is not a worker, environment, or authoritative check failure
transitions.effect: prepare FAILED outcome with the exact internal failure code and retained recovery evidence

transitions.guard: cancellation is authorized or immediate safety stop is required
transitions.effect: stop or quarantine harmful activity before best-effort checkpoint

transitions.guard: safe exact continuation is possible and no harmful action continues
transitions.effect: save the exact next ready work and stop all children

transitions.guard: continuation is unavailable or not authorized
transitions.effect: prepare PARTIAL outcome

transitions.guard: activation, contract, request, target, and saved state validate
transitions.effect: reacquire required provider support before exact continuation

transitions.guard: the prior owner is proven stale, every owned process is proven drained, and the exact checkpoint and next ready work validate
transitions.effect: save the crashed state and exact next ready work; any prepared, uncertain, or committed external effect changes the safe resume state to CHECK_WORK for reconciliation and is never blindly repeated

transitions.guard: the required capabilities are freshly verified for the saved route, effect, activation, runtime identity, and exact next ready work
transitions.effect: restore the saved checkpoint without starting a route analyst or repeating the L0 route decision

transitions.guard: the message adds to or replaces recorded instructions
transitions.effect: append an immutable steering edge

transitions.guard: new entries and object hashes validate
transitions.effect: walk the dependency invalidation graph

transitions.guard: unaffected results remain bound to their exact input set
transitions.effect: re-evaluate only the smallest necessary part

transitions.guard: saved state cannot be interpreted by the pinned contract
transitions.effect: run only a named tested migration

transitions.guard: migration output validates and preserves immutable inputs
transitions.effect: restore the saved state named in the migration record

transitions.guard: the restored state is nonterminal and legal under this contract
transitions.effect: continue without silently reinterpreting progress

transitions.guard: no tested compatible migration exists and no target lock is held
transitions.effect: report exact incompatible versions

transitions.guard: pending outcome is DONE and owned processes and resources are stopped
transitions.effect: record the terminal state last

transitions.guard: pending outcome is PARTIAL and exact completed work and next work are recorded
transitions.effect: record the terminal state last

transitions.guard: pending outcome is BLOCKED with cause and unblock path
transitions.effect: record the terminal state last

transitions.guard: pending outcome is CANCELLED and no harmful action continues
transitions.effect: record the terminal state last

transitions.guard: pending outcome is FAILED with recovery details
transitions.effect: record the terminal state last
